ch07.sum: The Isle of Paradise is encircled by the billion worlds of Havona, and between them revolve the twenty-one satellite worlds of the Father, the Son, and the Spirit. This Paradise-Havona system did not arise by evolution; it is an eternal universe created perfect from the beginning, and all the universes of time and space revolve around it. Havona is the pattern that the Creator Sons seek to reproduce in their own universes, a place of joy and satisfaction for the Deities, and for ascending mortals the portal to Paradise. This chapter considers the nature of the perfect central universe, the mysteries of the Paradise satellites, life and adventure in Havona, and the meaning of the whole system for the Gods and for man.
ch07.s1.u1.k: Havona, the perfect and divine universe, occupies the center of all creation.
ch07.s1.u1.p: All the universes of time and space revolve around a single core. At its center lies the motionless Isle of Paradise, and this central planetary family is called Havona. Our Nebadon is far distant from it, yet the whole universe is connected to this perfect center. Life on the periphery is still open toward the center.

text: THE perfect and divine universe occupies the center of all creation; it is the eternal core around which the vast creations of time and space revolve. Paradise is the gigantic nuclear Isle of absolute stability which rests motionless at the very heart of the magnificent eternal universe. This central planetary family is called Havona and is far-distant from the local universe of Nebadon.

ch07.s1.u2.k: Havona is not an evolutionary development but a pattern universe created perfect from the beginning.
ch07.s1.u2.p: The evolutionary universes move toward perfection through trial, error, and growth, but Havona has been perfect from the beginning. The bold adventure of the Creator Sons is an attempt to realize this very pattern in time and space. Havona has no courts and no legislatures; because every being walks the right way by nature, no government is needed. The ideal of true self-government is realized there.

text: This is a wholly created and perfect universe; it is not an evolutionary development. This is the eternal core of perfection, about which swirls that endless procession of universes which constitute the tremendous evolutionary experiment, the audacious adventure of the Creator Sons of God, who aspire to duplicate in time and to reproduce in space the pattern universe, the ideal of divine completeness, supreme finality, ultimate reality, and eternal perfection.

Concerning the government of the central universe, there is none. Havona is so exquisitely perfect that no intellectual system of government is required. There are no regularly constituted courts, neither are there legislative assemblies; Havona requires only administrative direction. Here may be observed the height of the ideals of true self-government.

ch07.s2.u1.k: The twenty-one satellite worlds of the Father, the Son, and the Spirit are eternal like Paradise.
ch07.s2.u1.p: Between Paradise and Havona lie special spheres in three circuits of seven: the worlds of the Father, the luminous worlds of the Son, and the worlds of the Spirit. Even their composition is unrevealed, and there is neither record nor tradition of their origin. The confession that even the revelators do not know everything reminds us that the universe cannot be fully organized by human knowledge.

text: These three seven-world circuits of the Father, the Son, and the Spirit are spheres of unexcelled grandeur and unimagined glory. Even their material or physical construction is of an order unrevealed to you. … As far as we know they have always been; like Paradise they are eternal. There exists neither record nor tradition of their origin.

ch07.s2.u2.k: Divinington is the bosom of the Father and the Paradise rendezvous of the Thought Adjusters.
ch07.s2.u2.p: The Thought Adjuster that indwells man comes from Divinington, one of the Father's satellite worlds. It is the sphere of the Father's personal communion and the home of many beings who take origin in the Father. That the Mystery Monitor within us is linked to that bosom of the Father shows that the innermost depth of man is connected to the innermost center of the universe.

text: DIVININGTON. This world is, in a unique sense, the "bosom of the Father," the personal-communion sphere of the Universal Father, and thereon is a special manifestation of his divinity. Divinington is the Paradise rendezvous of the Thought Adjusters, but it is also the home of numerous other entities, personalities, and other beings taking origin in the Universal Father.

ch07.s2.u3.k: What determines the differential of spiritual presence is the choice of our own minds and wills.
ch07.s2.u3.p: The Master Spirits carry the spirit of Deity to the seven superuniverses, but how real that presence is to each person depends on the one who receives it. That differential lies in nothing else than the manner of our own choosing, the decisions of our minds, and the determination of our wills. That the Almighty humbly obeys the choosing of creatures is an astonishing statement. How near God feels finally depends on how far the door of our heart is open.

text: The determiner of the differential of spiritual presence exists in your own hearts and minds and consists in the manner of your own choosing, in the decisions of your minds, and in the determination of your own wills. … And thus does the spirit of divinity become humbly obedient to the choosing of the creatures of the realms.

ch07.s3.u1.k: From the short test on Urantia to the seven circuits of Havona, every stage of ascent has a task to achieve.
ch07.s3.u1.p: The path of ascent is not aimless wandering but an education with a purpose at every stage. One who passes the short and intense test on Urantia finally achieves intellectual, spiritual, and experiential attainment on the seven circuits of Havona, with a definite task on every world. Havona's rules are not arbitrary; they are fairness, the union of righteousness and justice. There, doing what ought to be done becomes a natural joy.

text: On Urantia you pass through a short and intense test during your initial life of material existence. … On the seven circuits of Havona your attainment is intellectual, spiritual, and experiential. And there is a definite task to be achieved on each of the worlds of each of these circuits.

The regulations of the central universe are fittingly and inherently natural; the rules of conduct are not arbitrary. In every requirement of Havona there is disclosed the reason of righteousness and the rule of justice. And these two factors, combined, equal what on Urantia would be denominated fairness. When you arrive in Havona, you will naturally enjoy doing things the way they should be done.

ch07.s3.u2.k: Havoners exult in divine beauty, man rejoices in God's goodness, and both enjoy the liberty of living truth.
ch07.s3.u2.p: Perfect beings and evolving beings please God in different ways. The worship of the faith sons of the evolutionary worlds satisfies the Father's love, while the adoration of the Havoners fulfills the ideals of beauty and truth. Man rejoices in the goodness of God; the Havoner exults in divine beauty. It is beautiful that from such different starting points both enjoy the same liberty of truth.

text: As the worship of the faith sons of the evolutionary worlds ministers to the satisfaction of the Universal Father's love, so the exalted adoration of the Havona creatures satiates the perfect ideals of divine beauty and truth. … Man rejoices in the goodness of God, Havoners exult in the divine beauty, while you both enjoy the ministry of the liberty of living truth.

ch07.s3.u3.k: Until the last Havona world is visited, the tonic of adventure and the stimulus of curiosity will not disappear.
ch07.s3.u3.p: The idea that a perfect world must be boring is a human misunderstanding. The text says monotony comes from immaturity of the creative imagination. Each of Havona's billion worlds is new, and by the time ascenders arrive they are emotionally, intellectually, and socially mature. When the adventure of time is spent, the urge of eternity takes its place. Maturity yields not boredom but deeper discovery.

text: Not until you traverse the last of the Havona circuits and visit the last of the Havona worlds, will the tonic of adventure and the stimulus of curiosity disappear from your career. And then will the urge, the forward impulse of eternity, replace its forerunner, the adventure lure of time.

Monotony is indicative of immaturity of the creative imagination and inactivity of intellectual co-ordination with the spiritual endowment. By the time an ascendant mortal begins the exploration of these heavenly worlds, he has already attained emotional, intellectual, and social, if not spiritual, maturity.

ch07.s3.u4.k: Love of adventure and curiosity are divine endowments suggesting that death is only the beginning of an eternal voyage of discovery.
ch07.s3.u4.p: In our short life on earth, curiosity and love of adventure are often restrained and disappointed. Yet the text says these urges were not given to torment us. They are longings to be fully satisfied in the long ages to come, signs pointing ahead to the truth that death is not an end but the beginning of an everlasting life of anticipation. A dream thwarted today is, within the eternal plan, a promise deferred.

text: Love of adventure, curiosity, and dread of monotony—these traits inherent in evolving human nature—were not put there just to aggravate and annoy you during your short sojourn on earth, but rather to suggest to you that death is only the beginning of an endless career of adventure, an everlasting life of anticipation, an eternal voyage of discovery.

Curiosity—the spirit of investigation, the urge of discovery, the drive of exploration—is a part of the inborn and divine endowment of evolutionary space creatures. These natural impulses were not given you merely to be frustrated and repressed. True, these ambitious urges must frequently be restrained during your short life on earth, disappointment must be often experienced, but they are to be fully realized and gloriously gratified during the long ages to come.

ch07.s4: What Havona Means to the Gods and to Man
ch07.s4.u1.k: The Father views Havona with never-ending satisfaction as the worthy goal of his mortal grandchildren.
ch07.s4.u1.p: Havona gives the Father supreme achievement gratification. While the eternal urge toward infinite expansion unfolds slowly in time and space, the perfection of Havona compensates for the delay. And the Father rejoices in Havona as the home his mortal grandchildren of space will finally reach. Our arrival is something awaited on God's side as well.

text: Havona affords the Father supreme achievement gratification. The perfection realization in Havona compensates for the time-space delay of the eternal urge of infinite expansion.

The eternal Father views with never-ending satisfaction the Havona creation as the worthy and alluring goal for the ascension candidates of time, his mortal grandchildren of space achieving their Creator-Father's eternal home. And God takes pleasure in the Paradise-Havona universe as the eternal home of Deity and the divine family.

ch07.s4.u2.k: Havona is the pre-Paradise training goal of every ascending mortal and the portal to God.
ch07.s4.u2.p: In Havona mortals attain pre-Paradise Deity, the Supreme Being. It is the portal standing before every will creature, the place where every human impulse toward true spirit values is quickened. Yet Havona is not the end; for the finaliters it becomes the starting point of an eternal adventure in exploring the infinity of the Father. Every arrival is a new beginning.

text: These worlds provide the stimulus of all human impulses towards the attainment of true spirit values on the highest conceivable reality levels. Havona is the pre-Paradise training goal of every ascending mortal. Here mortals attain pre-Paradise Deity—the Supreme Being. Havona stands before every will creature as the portal to Paradise and God attainment.

The central universe is not only man's established destiny, but it is also the starting place of the eternal career of the finaliters as they shall sometime be started out on the undisclosed and universal adventure in the experience of exploring the infinity of the Universal Father.

ch07.qs1: What hope and standard does a perfect pattern at the center of the universe offer me as I live in an imperfect world?
ch07.qs2: If how near God's presence feels depends on my choice, how can I open the door of my heart today?
ch07.qs3: Which of my curiosities and dreams, restrained now, do I hope to see fulfilled in the eternal career?
ch08.sum: The universe pictured in the Urantia Book is not space scattered without end but a single co-ordinated whole with definite limits and order. The eternal Paradise-Havona system forms its nucleus, the seven superuniverses swing around it, and in the outer space levels creations yet to come are in preparation. What holds this vast system together are the gravity circuits that act upon matter, mind, spirit, and personality, and the stability of the whole is in the end proportional to divinity. This chapter looks in turn at the structure of the master universe, the theological meaning of gravity, the seven superuniverses and Orvonton, and the place of our world within its local universe. Cosmology, before it is astronomy, is a confession of how God upholds all things.
ch08.s1.u1.k: The universe of universes is not endless space but a bounded and co-ordinated whole.
ch08.s1.u1.p: Modern cosmology is used to picturing the universe as space without center or edge. The Urantia Book says the opposite: the universe has definite dimensions and boundaries. To be bounded is not to be small but to be ordered. That the whole vast aggregation of force-energy and matter-power functions as a single space unit shows that the universe is not a random scattering but an organized and co-ordinated whole.

text: The universe of universes is not an infinite plane, a boundless cube, nor a limitless circle; it certainly has dimensions. The laws of physical organization and administration prove conclusively that the whole vast aggregation of force-energy and matter-power functions ultimately as a space unit, as an organized and co-ordinated whole.

ch08.s1.u2.k: The Paradise-Havona system is the eternal nucleus of the master universe, and all creation revolves around it.
ch08.s1.u2.p: At the center of the universe stands a perfect creation that does not evolve. The universes of time revolve around this eternal nucleus and are governed from Paradise through the Seven Master Spirits. The arrangement is spatial, and it is also a theological picture: a cosmos in which the imperfect moves around the perfect and time advances toward eternity.

text: The Paradise-Havona System, the eternal universe encircling the eternal Isle, constitutes the perfect and eternal nucleus of the master universe; all seven of the superuniverses and all regions of outer space revolve in established orbits around the gigantic central aggregation of the Paradise satellites and the Havona spheres.

Seven superuniverses make up the present organized grand universe, consisting of approximately seven trillion inhabitable worlds plus the architectural spheres and the one billion inhabited spheres of Havona. The superuniverses are ruled and administered indirectly and reflectively from Paradise by the Seven Master Spirits.

ch08.s1.u3.k: Beyond the creations of eternity and of time, creations yet to come are in preparation.
ch08.s1.u3.p: The central universe belongs to eternity, the seven superuniverses to time, and the four outer space levels beyond them are reserved for a future not yet opened. There the ultimacy of creation is destined to eventuate and evolve. That the universe is not now complete means that God's creation is still in progress and that another chapter will open beyond eternity and time.

text: The central universe is the creation of eternity; the seven superuniverses are the creations of time; the four outer space levels are undoubtedly destined to eventuate-evolve the ultimacy of creation.

ch08.s2: Gravity: The Presence That Holds All Things
ch08.s2.u1.k: All energy, material, mindal, and spiritual, and all personality respond to their own gravity circuits.
ch08.s2.u1.p: In the Urantia Book gravity is not merely a term of physics. Alongside the gravity of Paradise that grasps matter there is the spirit gravity of the Son, the mind gravity of the Conjoint Actor, and the personality gravity of the Father. All four are circuits of absolute presence. No reality in the universe lies outside the grasp of God.

text: All forms of force-energy—material, mindal, or spiritual—are alike subject to those grasps, those universal presences, which we call gravity. Personality also is responsive to gravity—to the Father's exclusive circuit; but though this circuit is exclusive to the Father, he is not excluded from the other circuits; the Universal Father is infinite and acts over all four absolute-gravity circuits in the master universe:
1. The Personality Gravity of the Universal Father.
2. The Spirit Gravity of the Eternal Son.
3. The Mind Gravity of the Conjoint Actor.
4. The Cosmic Gravity of the Isle of Paradise.

ch08.s2.u2.k: The spirit gravity of the Eternal Son is as real as the material grasp of Paradise.
ch08.s2.u2.p: Man tends to treat visible forces as real and invisible ones as less real. The text declares that spiritual gravity is just as real and absolute as material gravity, though it is discerned only by the insight of the soul. Matter is bound by linear gravity, mind becomes truly liberated when modified by spirit, and true spirit is not subject to physical gravity at all.

text: The bestowal of spirit and the spiritualization of personalities, the domain of spiritual gravity, is the realm of the Eternal Son. And this spirit gravity of the Son, ever drawing all spiritual realities to himself, is just as real and absolute as is the all-powerful material grasp of the Isle of Paradise. But material-minded man is naturally more familiar with the material manifestations of a physical nature than with the equally real and mighty operations of a spiritual nature which are discerned only by the spiritual insight of the soul.
1. Matter. Organized energy which is subject to linear gravity except as it is modified by motion and conditioned by mind.
2. Mind. Organized consciousness which is not wholly subject to material gravity, and which becomes truly liberated when modified by spirit.
3. Spirit. The highest personal reality. True spirit is not subject to physical gravity but eventually becomes the motivating influence of all evolving energy systems of personality dignity.

ch08.s2.u3.k: Universe stability is proportional not to inertia but to divinity.
ch08.s2.u3.p: The universe does not hold together because it is motionless. Balanced energies, co-operative minds, spirit overcontrol, and personality unification sustain it, and at the source of all this control stands the Father working through Paradise, the Eternal Son, and the Conjoint Actor. The principle holds for a single life as well: true stability comes from divinity.

text: The universe is nonstatic. Stability is not the result of inertia but rather the product of balanced energies, co-operative minds, co-ordinated morontias, spirit overcontrol, and personality unification. Stability is wholly and always proportional to divinity.

In the physical control of the master universe the Universal Father exercises priority and primacy through the Isle of Paradise; God is absolute in the spiritual administration of the cosmos in the person of the Eternal Son. Concerning the domains of mind, the Father and the Son function co-ordinately in the Conjoint Actor.

ch08.s3.u1.k: To the Father the universes are homes of personalities, and the grand universe is framed like one gigantic wheel.
ch08.s3.u1.p: It is striking to read that, as far as the Father is concerned, the universes are virtually nonexistent. What the Father deals with is not universes but personalities; he is the Father of personalities. And the whole turns like one wheel, with Paradise as its hub and the Seven Master Spirits as its spokes. Order and love stand together in a single picture.

text: AS FAR as the Universal Father is concerned—as a Father—the universes are virtually nonexistent; he deals with personalities; he is the Father of personalities. … The Seven Master Spirits radiate their influence out from the central Isle, thus constituting the vast creation one gigantic wheel, the hub being the eternal Isle of Paradise, the seven spokes the radiations of the Seven Master Spirits, the rim the outer regions of the grand universe.

ch08.s3.u2.k: Each superuniverse has its own purpose and nature, and Orvonton is a demonstration of love and mercy.
ch08.s3.u2.p: The seven superuniverses are not copies repeating one pattern; each is entrusted with the fullest expression of one major purpose. Orvonton, our own, is known for its merciful ministry, a realm where justice is tempered by mercy and power is conditioned by patience. Even the trials of our world are to be read within the larger setting of this universe of mercy.

text: There are seven major purposes which are being unfolded in the evolution of the seven superuniverses. Each major purpose in superuniverse evolution will find fullest expression in only one of the seven superuniverses, and therefore does each superuniverse have a special function and a unique nature.

Orvonton, the seventh superuniverse, the one to which your local universe belongs, is known chiefly because of its tremendous and lavish bestowal of merciful ministry to the mortals of the realms. It is renowned for the manner in which justice prevails as tempered by mercy and power rules as conditioned by patience, while the sacrifices of time are freely made to secure the stabilization of eternity. Orvonton is a universe demonstration of love and mercy.

ch08.s3.u3.k: Only the Father knows the number of inhabited worlds, and he calls them all by name and number.
ch08.s3.u3.p: A figure of some seven trillion inhabitable worlds overwhelms the human mind. Yet before giving any number, the text says that the Father knows them all and calls each by name. Immensity is not a reason for God to seem far away; it is evidence of how wide his care extends. Not one of those many worlds lies outside his knowledge.

text: Only the Universal Father knows the location and actual number of inhabited worlds in space; he calls them all by name and number.

ch08.s4: The Local Universe and Our World
ch08.s4.u1.k: Each local universe is set apart by the space presence of the Creative Spirit.
ch08.s4.u1.p: The boundary of a local universe is set not by physical measurement but by the presence of a divine person. Nebadon is the realm pervaded by the Universe Mother Spirit. Within it Urantia lies near the borderland of the local universe, on the periphery of Orvonton. To be far from the center is not to be forsaken; a borderland world dwells in the same presence of the Mother Spirit.

text: THE characteristic space phenomenon which sets off each local creation from all others is the presence of the Creative Spirit. … That which is pervaded by our local universe Mother Spirit is Nebadon; that which extends beyond her space presence is outside Nebadon, being the extra-Nebadon space regions of the superuniverse of Orvonton—other local universes.

Urantia belongs to a system which is well out towards the borderland of your local universe; and your local universe is at present traversing the periphery of Orvonton. Beyond you there are still others, but you are far removed in space from those physical systems which swing around the great circle in comparative proximity to the Great Source and Center.

ch08.s4.u2.k: Our world is not plunging blindly into unknown space but follows a predetermined path.
ch08.s4.u2.p: Faced with the vastness of space, man easily feels adrift. The text says that our planetary system is following the orderly and predetermined path of its space level, and that our sun and earth are offspring of the Andronover nebula. Our world belongs to a young universe not yet fully organized, yet its course lies within a plan, not in chaos.

text: You belong to one of the relatively recent universes. But you are not, today, plunging on wildly into uncharted space nor swinging out blindly into unknown regions. You are following the orderly and predetermined path of the superuniverse space level.

Urantia is of origin in your sun, and your sun is one of the multifarious offspring of the Andronover nebula, which was onetime organized as a component part of the physical power and material matter of the local universe of Nebadon. And this great nebula itself took origin in the universal force-charge of space in the superuniverse of Orvonton, long, long ago.

ch08.s4.u3.k: The foundation of the universe is material, but the essence of life is spirit.
ch08.s4.u3.p: To study the material universe is to learn the divine technique one phase at a time. There is in matter a form of energy not yet known, and when it is discovered physicists will feel they have almost solved the mystery of matter. Yet though the foundation of the universe is material, the essence of life is spirit, and the Father of spirits is the ancestor of universes. Cosmology thus holds science and faith together.

text: The foundation of the universe is material, but the essence of life is spirit. The Father of spirits is also the ancestor of universes; the eternal Father of the Original Son is also the eternity-source of the original pattern, the Isle of Paradise.

There is innate in matter and present in universal space a form of energy not known on Urantia. When this discovery is finally made, then will physicists feel that they have solved, almost at least, the mystery of matter.

ch08.qs1: What sense of stability does it give my outlook to see the universe as an ordered whole rather than endless chaos?
ch08.qs2: Have I ever felt the unseen pull of spirit to be as real as material force? When?
ch08.qs3: How might I understand living on a small borderland world in the light of God's care?
ch09.sub: The Universe of a Creator Son and Its Government
ch09.sum: Nebadon, the universe to which our world belongs, is a local universe organized by a Creator Son of the order of Michael together with the Universe Mother Spirit. Destined to comprise one hundred constellations and ten thousand systems, it was not finished from the start but is a creation evolving both physically and spiritually. This chapter considers how a local universe comes into being and why perfection was planned to be gained through experience rather than bestowed as a gift. It then turns to the way the Universal Father rules the local universe through the person of the Creator Son and freely distributes himself, to the dual supervision of father and mother, and to the justice of universe administration. Finally it sees how the eternal purpose in the march of the universes keeps each of our struggles from being in vain.
ch09.s1: The Birth of a Local Universe
ch09.s1.u1.k: A local universe is the handiwork of a Creator Son, and all universes of time and space are evolutionary.
ch09.s1.u1.p: A local universe is the basic creative unit of the grand universe, and it bears the name and character of a single Creator Son. Yet it is not given complete from the start. Its physical structure, and the minds and spirits of the creatures who live in it, are planned to grow by degrees. The creation of the Michaels is not finished by one command; it is a process of growth across long ages.

text: A LOCAL universe is the handiwork of a Creator Son of the Paradise order of Michael. It comprises one hundred constellations, each embracing one hundred systems of inhabited worlds. Each system will eventually contain approximately one thousand inhabited spheres.

These universes of time and space are all evolutionary. The creative plan of the Paradise Michaels always proceeds along the path of gradual evolvement and progressive development of the physical, intellectual, and spiritual natures and capacities of the manifold creatures who inhabit the varied orders of spheres comprising such a local universe.

ch09.s1.u2.k: The Creator Son comes with the Creative Spirit to build the physical universe and to project the creation of life.
ch09.s1.u2.p: The creation of a local universe follows an order. When energy has reached a certain stage of materialization, the Creator Son appears with a Creative Daughter of the Infinite Spirit and begins with the headquarters world. Only after the physical plan is complete is the creation of life projected, and its first fruit is the Bright and Morning Star. From the beginning the partnership of Son and Spirit is the basic form of local universe creation.

text: When energy-matter has attained a certain stage in mass materialization, a Paradise Creator Son appears upon the scene, accompanied by a Creative Daughter of the Infinite Spirit. Simultaneously with the arrival of the Creator Son, work is begun upon the architectural sphere which is to become the headquarters world of the projected local universe.

Presently, the physical plan of a universe is completed, and the Creator Son, in association with the Creative Spirit, projects his plan of life creation; whereupon does this representation of the Infinite Spirit begin her universe function as a distinct creative personality. When this first creative act is formulated and executed, there springs into being the Bright and Morning Star, the personification of this initial creative concept of identity and ideal of divinity.

ch09.s1.u3.k: When the universe is ready, the Creator Son joins the Father's proposal to create man in the divine image.
ch09.s1.u3.p: Mortal man appears only late in the work of universe creation, and in a sense all that comes before is preparation for his arrival. Nor is the creation of man the Creator Son's idea alone; it is his response to the Father's proposal. The sovereign of our universe is the very Michael who came as Jesus of Nazareth, and his plans were approved by the Paradise Trinity from the beginning.

text: And then, when such a universe has been so completely organized and so repletely manned, does the Creator Son enter into the Father's proposal to create mortal man in their divine image.

Urantia belongs to a local universe whose sovereign is the God-man of Nebadon, Jesus of Nazareth and Michael of Salvington. And all of Michael's plans for this local universe were fully approved by the Paradise Trinity before he ever embarked upon the supreme adventure of space.

ch09.s2.u1.k: Outside the central universe, perfection is a progressive attainment and a true personal possession.
ch09.s2.u1.p: Havona holds the pattern of perfection, but the universes of time must reach that perfection by their own methods. The perfection gained in this way is not borrowed; it belongs to the creature. Grace is freely mixed in, yet the attainment itself comes from actual living and effort. Grace and effort do not cancel each other; they work together.

text: Except in the central universe, perfection is a progressive attainment. In the central creation we have a pattern of perfection, but all other realms must attain that perfection by the methods established for the advancement of those particular worlds or universes.

The perfection of the creatures of time, when finally achieved, is wholly an acquirement, a bona fide personality possession. While the elements of grace are freely admixed, nevertheless, the creature attainments are the result of individual effort and actual living, personality reaction to the existing environment.

ch09.s2.u2.k: Animal origin is no stigma, and greater honor belongs to those who climb the ladder of life from the bottom.
ch09.s2.u2.p: That man evolved from animal ancestry has long been treated as a religious embarrassment. The text says it is the only way to produce one basic type of will creature, and even a starting point of honor. God could have made all perfect by a word, but that would deprive them of the adventure and training of the climb from the bottom. A lowly start is not misfortune but good fortune.

text: The fact of animal evolutionary origin does not attach stigma to any personality in the sight of the universe as that is the exclusive method of producing one of the two basic types of finite intelligent will creatures.

It would be just as easy for the Universal Father to make all mortals perfect beings, to impart perfection by his divine word. But that would deprive them of the wonderful experience of the adventure and training associated with the long and gradual inward climb, an experience to be had only by those who are so fortunate as to begin at the very bottom of living existence.

ch09.s3: The Father's Rule Through the Son
ch09.s3.u1.k: In the local universe the Universal Father rules through the person of the Creator Son.
ch09.s3.u1.p: That the Father rules all creation and that he entrusts a local universe to a Son do not contradict each other. The Father does not otherwise intervene in local universe administration but delegates it to the Creator Son, the Universe Mother Spirit, and their children. The Father functions through the person of the Creator Son and does not otherwise handle the administration. Delegation is the basic manner of God's rule.

text: WHILE the Universal Father most certainly rules over his vast creation, he functions in a local universe administration through the person of the Creator Son. The Father does not otherwise personally function in the administrative affairs of a local universe. These matters are intrusted to the Creator Son and to the local universe Mother Spirit and to their manifold children.

ch09.s3.u2.k: There is no division of authority among the Deities; divine power and purpose never cross.
ch09.s3.u2.p: That the Father does not step directly into the affairs of a local universe is not indifference but trust. The law of the Creator Son and the rule of the Constellation Fathers, System Sovereigns, and Planetary Princes, the ordained policies of that universe, always prevail. Authority is not divided, and divine power and purpose never work at cross-purposes. This is possible because the Deities are in perfect and eternal unanimity.

text: The law of the Creator Son, the rule of the Constellation Fathers, the System Sovereigns, and the Planetary Princes—the ordained policies and procedures for that universe—always prevail. There is no division of authority; never is there a cross working of divine power and purpose. The Deities are in perfect and eternal unanimity.

ch09.s3.u3.k: God is not a self-centered personality; he freely distributes himself to his creation.
ch09.s3.u3.p: Delegation is an expression of love before it is an administrative technique for sharing power. The Father has divested himself of every function another can perform and lives and works in his Sons. And if anything of himself remains after such giving, he bestows even that upon mortals as Thought Adjusters. The very structure of the local universe bears witness to God's generosity.

text: God is not a self-centered personality; the Father freely distributes himself to his creation and to his creatures. He lives and acts, not only in the Deities, but also in his Sons, whom he intrusts with the doing of everything that it is divinely possible for them to do. The Universal Father has truly divested himself of every function which it is possible for another being to perform.

If God has withheld aught of himself from the universal creation, then of that residue he is in lavish generosity bestowing the Thought Adjusters upon the mortals of the realms, the Mystery Monitors of time, who so patiently indwell the mortal candidates for life everlasting.

ch09.s4.u1.k: The local universe is under the dual supervision of the Creator Son and the Creative Spirit as father and mother.
ch09.s4.u1.p: Up to the superuniverses, administration rests with personalities of Trinity origin, but in the local universe the concept of father and mother begins. If the Creator Son is the universe father, the Divine Minister is the universe mother. Yet the link with Paradise is not broken: every local universe is blessed with the presence of personalities from the central universe and Paradise.

text: The local universes are characterized by dual supervision, the beginning of the father-mother concept. The universe father is the Creator Son; the universe mother is the Divine Minister, the local universe Creative Spirit. Every local universe is, however, blessed with the presence of certain personalities from the central universe and Paradise.

ch09.s4.u2.k: Creators never judge their creatures, and in the universe justice and divine equity prevail.
ch09.s4.u2.p: Michael is concerned with three things: creation, sustenance, and ministry. Judgment belongs to those who have had actual creature experience. The principle that the maker does not sit in judgment reflects a deep care for fairness. However unjust the verdicts of this world may sometimes seem, we live in an ordered universe and will in the end be dealt with justly, even mercifully.

text: The Master Son, Michael, is supremely concerned with but three things: creation, sustenance, and ministry. He does not personally participate in the judicial work of the universe. Creators never sit in judgment on their creatures; that is the exclusive function of creatures of high training and actual creature experience.

However unfairly human contentions may sometimes appear to be adjudicated on Urantia, in the universe justice and divine equity do prevail. You are living in a well-ordered universe, and sooner or later you may depend upon being dealt with justly, even mercifully.

ch09.s5.u1.k: There is a glorious purpose in the march of the universes, and our struggling is not in vain.
ch09.s5.u1.p: A single life is short, and the part of the cosmic plan visible within it is very small, so man easily feels that his labor counts for nothing. The text says that we are all part of an eternal project supervised by the Gods. That we cannot see the whole does not mean there is no plan; it means the plan is that great.

text: There is a great and glorious purpose in the march of the universes through space. All of your mortal struggling is not in vain. We are all part of an immense plan, a gigantic enterprise, and it is the vastness of the undertaking that renders it impossible to see very much of it at any one time and during any one life. We are all a part of an eternal project which the Gods are supervising and outworking.

ch09.s5.u2.k: God's plan embraces every creature, and the race for perfection is open to whoever will.
ch09.s5.u2.p: The long account of the local universe ends at last in an invitation to each person. God's plan promises boundless opportunity and endless life, and its treasures belong to those who strive. This race is not run alone: the leading of the indwelling Adjuster and the spirit poured out upon all flesh accompany every step.

text: There is in the mind of God a plan which embraces every creature of all his vast domains, and this plan is an eternal purpose of boundless opportunity, unlimited progress, and endless life. And the infinite treasures of such a matchless career are yours for the striving!

The race for perfection is on! whosoever will may enter, and certain victory will crown the efforts of every human being who will run the race of faith and trust, depending every step of the way on the leading of the indwelling Adjuster and on the guidance of that good spirit of the Universe Son, which so freely has been poured out upon all flesh.

ch09.qs1: How does the fact that perfection is meant to be gained through experience rather than given as a gift change the way I see my failures and growth?
ch09.qs2: What does God's generous delegation of authority teach me about how I entrust work to others?
ch09.qs3: How might the conviction that my small struggles belong to an eternal plan change the way I live today?
ch10.sum: The Urantia Book neither denies evolution nor regards it as the product of chance. Evolution is the method by which God works in the universes of time, and it is purposeful from beginning to end. Life does not arise spontaneously; the Life Carriers plant it on the planets according to plan, and the activating spark always comes from a creator. Because the physical controllers, the Life Carriers, and the adjutant mind-spirits of the Universe Mother Spirit work together, evolution is never accidental. This chapter considers in turn the origin of life, the evidence of purpose in evolution, the time and patience evolution requires, and the goal of evolution together with man's own responsibility. Evolution is not the enemy of faith but God's way of educating creatures upward from below.
ch10.s1.u1.k: Life does not arise spontaneously; the Life Carriers initiate it on the planets according to plan.
ch10.s1.u1.p: On the origin of life the Urantia Book takes a clear position. Life did not come about by matter happening to combine; it was designed by the Life Carriers and planted by them on barren planets. On our own world they first studied the physical conditions and then launched life. At the beginning of life there was intelligence and a plan.

text: Life does not spontaneously appear in the universes; the Life Carriers must initiate it on the barren planets. They are the carriers, disseminators, and guardians of life as it appears on the evolutionary worlds of space.

600,000,000 years ago the commission of Life Carriers sent out from Jerusem arrived on Urantia and began the study of physical conditions preparatory to launching life on world number 606 of the Satania system.

ch10.s1.u2.k: Life springs only from life, and the activating spark comes only from a creator.
ch10.s1.u2.p: Matter may exist on its own, but life comes only from life, mind only from mind, and spirit only from spirit. Creatures can produce the forms of life, but they cannot supply the spark that makes them live. Here lies the reason why science, however near it comes to the secret of life, never grasps it: to analyze life it must first kill it.

text: Things material may enjoy an independent existence, but life springs only from life. Mind can be derived only from pre-existent mind. Spirit takes origin only from spirit ancestors. The creature may produce the forms of life, but only a creator personality or a creative force can supply the activating living spark.

The chemist can elucidate the chemistry of dead protoplasm, but he cannot discern either the physical organization or the dynamic performance of living protoplasm. Ever will the scientist come nearer and nearer the secrets of life, but never will he find them and for no other reason than that he must kill protoplasm in order to analyze it.

ch10.s2.u1.k: Evolution is not chance but a purposeful process wrought by the integration of several divine ministries.
ch10.s2.u1.p: Evolution is guided by more than one hand. The physical controllers shape the framework of matter, the Seven Master Spirits impart life, and the Life Carriers foster its development. Basic evolutionary material life is the product of these three ministries working together, and the integrated functioning of the Life Carriers, the physical controllers, and the adjutant spirits conditions the course of organic evolution. Therefore evolution, wherever it occurs, is always purposeful and never accidental.

text: BASIC evolutionary material life—premind life—is the formulation of the Master Physical Controllers and the life-impartation ministry of the Seven Master Spirits in conjunction with the active ministration of the ordained Life Carriers.

It is the integrated functioning of the Life Carriers, the physical controllers, and the spirit adjutants that conditions the course of organic evolution on the inhabited worlds. And this is why evolution—on Urantia or elsewhere—is always purposeful and never accidental.

ch10.s2.u2.k: The adjutant mind-spirits of the Universe Mother Spirit lead evolving mind toward spirit receptivity.
ch10.s2.u2.p: A second reason evolution is purposeful lies in the ministry to mind. From the moment the ability to learn from experience appears, the adjutant mind-spirits begin to function. They are children of the Universe Mother Spirit, and they carry on a long preliminary ministry from the lowliest minds up to man. An unseen hand accompanies the animal mind until at last it becomes capable of worship.

text: It is the presence of the seven adjutant mind-spirits on the primitive worlds that conditions the course of organic evolution; that explains why evolution is purposeful and not accidental. … The adjutants are the children of the Universe Mother Spirit and constitute her personal ministry to the material minds of the realms.

The acquisition of the potential of the ability to learn from experience marks the beginning of the functioning of the adjutant spirits, and they function from the lowliest minds of primitive and invisible existences up to the highest types in the evolutionary scale of human beings. … Long must these faithful and always dependable influences carry forward their preliminary ministry before the animal mind attains the human levels of spirit receptivity.

ch10.s2.u3.k: Many features of the human body bear witness that life was intelligently planned.
ch10.s2.u3.p: The evidence of life's design is not far away. The text says that many features of human life give abundant proof that mortal existence was intelligently planned. These things are simply too familiar to astonish us, yet organic evolution is no mere cosmic accident. The marks of design lie not in distant stars but in our own bodies.

text: Many features of human life afford abundant evidence that the phenomenon of mortal existence was intelligently planned, that organic evolution is not a mere cosmic accident.

ch10.s2.u4.k: New species appear suddenly, not through the accumulation of small variations.
ch10.s2.u4.p: The evolution the Urantia Book describes is not only an endless piling up of tiny changes. From era to era radically new orders of life appear suddenly and fully formed. In this way life that began in the ooze of the ocean bed came at last to man, the lord of earthly creation. This long story of biologic struggle and mind survival advances by purposeful leaps.

text: From era to era radically new species of animal life arise. They do not evolve as the result of the gradual accumulation of small variations; they appear as full-fledged and new orders of life, and they appear suddenly.

The story of man's ascent from seaweed to the lordship of earthly creation is indeed a romance of biologic struggle and mind survival. Man's primordial ancestors were literally the slime and ooze of the ocean bed in the sluggish and warm-water bays and lagoons of the vast shore lines of the ancient inland seas, those very waters in which the Life Carriers established the three independent life implantations on Urantia.

ch10.s3.u1.k: Evolution takes long because it must wait upon the physical development of a planet.
ch10.s3.u1.p: That the evolution of life took hundreds of millions of years raises the question why God, if he exists, works so slowly. The Life Carrier's answer is modest: life cannot unfold faster than the physical changes of the planet permit. And on Paradise, from which we are ruled, time does not exist. What seems slow to us is no delay in the eyes of eternity.

text: If spending so much time in effecting the evolutionary changes of life development occasions perplexity, I would say that we cannot time the life processes to unfold any faster than the physical metamorphoses of a planet will permit. … But we are all under the jurisdiction of the Supreme Rulers of Paradise, and time is nonexistent on Paradise.

ch10.s3.u2.k: The universe is not run for our convenience, and it behooves us to co-operate patiently with the rule of wisdom.
ch10.s3.u2.p: The path of evolution is long and slow, and man easily grows impatient. Yet the text answers not with complaint but with trust. The wise and all-powerful beings who manage the universe know exactly what they are about, so the same attitude is asked of Life Carriers and of men alike. What is asked of man is patient waiting and hearty co-operation.

text: The wise and all-powerful beings who are responsible for universe management undoubtedly know exactly what they are about; and so it becomes Life Carriers and behooves mortal minds to enlist in patient waiting and hearty co-operation with the rule of wisdom, the reign of power, and the march of progress.

ch10.s3.u3.k: The evolution of matter, mind, and spirit is intertwined, yet no obstacle can defeat the whole-souled choice of will.
ch10.s3.u3.p: In cosmic evolution mind dominates matter and spirit is correlated with mind, so delays can arise among these three intertwined realities. Yet the soul may evolve regardless of mental culture; what it needs is the choice of survival and the decision to do the Father's will. Physical limits or mental perversity may slow the way, but they cannot close it.

text: The soul may evolve regardless of mental culture but not in the absence of mental capacity and desire—the choice of survival and the decision to achieve ever-increasing perfection—to do the will of the Father in heaven. Although survival may not depend on the possession of knowledge and wisdom, progression most certainly does.

In the cosmic evolutionary laboratories mind is always dominant over matter, and spirit is ever correlated with mind. … Physical status may handicap mind, and mental perversity may delay spiritual attainment, but none of these obstacles can defeat the whole-souled choice of will.

ch10.s4: The Goal of Evolution and Human Responsibility
ch10.s4.u1.k: The goal of the evolutionary universes is for mind to master matter and spirit to direct mind.
ch10.s4.u1.p: Evolution has a direction. At first energy and matter dominate, but within personality spirit strives through mind for the mastery. The goal is a state in which matter is subordinate to mind and mind co-ordinated with spirit. When conditions are ripe, sudden transformations of mind and spirit may occur. Evolution is in the end a process that frees personality from the limits of time and space.

text: In the evolutionary superuniverses energy-matter is dominant except in personality, where spirit through the mediation of mind is struggling for the mastery. The goal of the evolutionary universes is the subjugation of energy-matter by mind, the co-ordination of mind with spirit, and all of this by virtue of the creative and unifying presence of personality.

When physical conditions are ripe, sudden mental evolutions may take place; when mind status is propitious, sudden spiritual transformations may occur; when spiritual values receive proper recognition, then cosmic meanings become discernible, and increasingly the personality is released from the handicaps of time and delivered from the limitations of space.

ch10.s4.u2.k: Man's evolutionary destiny is now in his own hands.
ch10.s4.u2.p: No new races will evolve hereafter from prehuman sources. Mankind must solve its problems of development with the stocks it has, and its evolutionary destiny now lies in its own hands. To accept evolution is not to fall into fatalism but to accept the call to shape the future with responsible intelligence in place of random selection.

text: Mankind on Urantia must solve its problems of mortal development with the human stocks it has—no more races will evolve from prehuman sources throughout all future time. … In a general way, man's evolutionary destiny is in his own hands, and scientific intelligence must sooner or later supersede the random functioning of uncontrolled natural selection and chance survival.

ch10.s4.u3.k: There is providence in the evolving universes, and it is seen to the extent that purpose is discerned.
ch10.s4.u3.p: Natural law often seems cruel and heartless, especially in the early stages of an evolutionary world. That does not mean there is no providence. Providence is discovered in proportion as the capacity to perceive universe purpose grows. The difference between seeing evolution as aimless struggle and seeing in it God's education depends in the end on the creature's spiritual maturity.

text: There is a providence in the evolving universes, and it can be discovered by creatures to just the extent that they have attained capacity to perceive the purpose of the evolving universes. Complete capacity to discern universe purposes equals the evolutionary completion of the creature and may otherwise be expressed as the attainment of the Supreme within the limits of the present state of the incomplete universes.

In the beginnings on an evolutionary world the natural occurrences of the material order and the personal desires of human beings often appear to be antagonistic. Much that takes place on an evolving world is rather hard for mortal man to understand—natural law is so often apparently cruel, heartless, and indifferent to all that is true, beautiful, and good in human comprehension.

ch10.qs1: How does seeing evolution as God's purposeful method change the relation between science and faith?
ch10.qs2: Have I known a change in my life that seemed slow at the time but proved, in hindsight, to need that time?
ch10.qs3: If man's evolutionary destiny is in our hands, what am I responsible for today on behalf of the next generation?
ch11.sub: The Seven Master Spirits and the Family of the Infinite Spirit
ch11.sum: Beyond Paradise and Havona the Infinite Spirit does not speak directly to the universes but speaks by the voices of the Seven Master Spirits. These Master Spirits were personalized in the first Deity-creating act of the Infinite Spirit, and each expresses one of the seven associative possibilities inherent in the three persons of Deity. They preside over the seven superuniverses of the grand universe and, as the sevenfold source of the cosmic mind, open to human minds the insights of science, morality, and worship. This chapter considers the origin and nature of the Master Spirits, their role as voice of the Infinite Spirit and source of cosmic mind, their relation to ascending mortals, and the unified ministry of the whole family of Supreme Spirits, including Majeston and the Reflective Spirits. God's spirit does not work alone from afar; through an ordered family of spirits it reaches from Paradise down to the mind of mortal man.
ch11.s1: Origin and Nature of the Master Spirits
ch11.s1.u1.k: The Seven Master Spirits are the primary personalities of the Infinite Spirit, exhausting the seven associative possibilities of the three Deities.
ch11.s1.u1.p: Why seven? The Urantia Book's answer is both mathematical and theological. There are exactly seven ways in which Father, Son, and Spirit can be expressed singly or in association. The Infinite Spirit personalized all those possibilities as the Seven Master Spirits. Hence the universe is operated in seven grand divisions, and the number seven is basic to its organization.

text: THE Seven Master Spirits of Paradise are the primary personalities of the Infinite Spirit. … Had it been possible to produce a larger number of Master Spirits, they would have been created, but there are just seven associative possibilities, and only seven, inherent in three Deities. And this explains why the universe is operated in seven grand divisions, and why the number seven is basically fundamental in its organization and administration.

The first Deity-creating act of the Infinite Spirit, functioning apart from the Trinity but in some unrevealed association with the Father and the Son, personalized in the existence of the Seven Master Spirits of Paradise, the distributors of the Infinite Spirit to the universes.

ch11.s1.u2.k: The Master Spirits are akin yet diverse in nature, and they fully represent the Infinite Spirit to the evolutionary universes.
ch11.s1.u2.p: Coming from the same Infinite Spirit, the Master Spirits are akin; expressing different associations of Deity, they differ in nature, and that difference shapes the character of each superuniverse. At the same time they represent the Third Source and Center in every relation of energy, mind, and spirit. They are literally "the Seven Spirits of God sent forth to all the universe."

text: The Seven Master Spirits are indescribable beings, but they are distinctly and definitely personal. … As primary personalizations of the Infinite Spirit, they are akin, but as primary expressions of the seven possible associations of triune Deity, they are essentially diverse in nature, and this diversity of nature determines their differential of superuniverse conduct.

The Seven Master Spirits are the full representation of the Infinite Spirit to the evolutionary universes. They represent the Third Source and Center in the relationships of energy, mind, and spirit. … It is literally true that these Seven Spirits are the personalized physical power, cosmic mind, and spiritual presence of the triune Deity, "the Seven Spirits of God sent forth to all the universe."

ch11.s2: Voice of the Infinite Spirit and Source of Cosmic Mind
ch11.s2.u1.k: Outside Paradise and Havona the Infinite Spirit speaks only by the voices of the Seven Master Spirits.
ch11.s2.u1.p: The Father speaks through the Son, and the Father and Son act through the Infinite Spirit; in the universes of time the Infinite Spirit speaks through the Seven Master Spirits. This is not a series of steps by which God withdraws but the way by which he draws near. A pilgrim who reaches the central universe may not at once discern the person of the Infinite Spirit, yet can immediately commune with the Master Spirit of his own superuniverse.

text: To the universe of universes the Paradise Father speaks only through his Son, while he and the Son conjointly act only through the Infinite Spirit. Outside of Paradise and Havona the Infinite Spirit speaks only by the voices of the Seven Master Spirits.

At the center of centers the Infinite Spirit is approachable, but not all who attain Paradise are immediately able to discern his personality and differentiated presence; but all who attain the central universe can and do immediately commune with one of the Seven Master Spirits, the one presiding over the superuniverse from which the newly arrived space pilgrim hails.

ch11.s2.u2.k: The Master Spirits are the sevenfold source of cosmic mind, and that mind has a reality response.
ch11.s2.u2.p: The human mind is not an isolated island; it is linked to the cosmic mind, whose source is the Seven Master Spirits. The cosmic mind has a quality that responds to reality, and it keeps will creatures from becoming helpless victims of the hidden assumptions of science, philosophy, or religion. Our very capacity to recognize what is real is a gift of these Spirits.

text: The Master Spirits are the sevenfold source of the cosmic mind, the intellectual potential of the grand universe. This cosmic mind is a subabsolute manifestation of the mind of the Third Source and Center and, in certain ways, is functionally related to the mind of the evolving Supreme Being.

There exists in all personality associations of the cosmic mind a quality which might be denominated the "reality response." It is this universal cosmic endowment of will creatures which saves them from becoming helpless victims of the implied a priori assumptions of science, philosophy, and religion.

ch11.s2.u3.k: The cosmic mind unfailingly responds on three levels of reality: causation, duty, and worship.
ch11.s2.u3.p: Science sees the uniformity of cause and effect, philosophy the obligation of right and wrong, and religion fellowship with God. The text says all three are innate insights rooted in the cosmic mind. They are not rival territories but three levels of one mind, and the highest of them is the insight of worship, the ascent from servant of God to son of God.

text: The cosmic mind unfailingly responds (recognizes response) on three levels of universe reality. These responses are self-evident to clear-reasoning and deep-thinking minds. These levels of reality are:

1. Causation—the reality domain of the physical senses, the scientific realms of logical uniformity, the differentiation of the factual and the nonfactual, reflective conclusions based on cosmic response. This is the mathematical form of the cosmic discrimination.
2. Duty—the reality domain of morals in the philosophic realm, the arena of reason, the recognition of relative right and wrong. This is the judicial form of the cosmic discrimination.

3. Worship—the spiritual domain of the reality of religious experience, the personal realization of divine fellowship, the recognition of spirit values, the assurance of eternal survival, the ascent from the status of servants of God to the joy and liberty of the sons of God. This is the highest insight of the cosmic mind, the reverential and worshipful form of the cosmic discrimination.

ch11.s3: The Master Spirits and Ascending Mortals
ch11.s3.u1.k: A Master Spirit does not directly invade the mortal mind but ministers through the local universe Creative Spirit.
ch11.s3.u1.p: The influence of the Master Spirits does not fall directly from on high into the human mind; their ministry comes through the Creative Mother Spirit of the local universe. That is why the mortals of Urantia do not directly experience the personal presence of the Master Spirit of Orvonton. God's order proceeds step by step, and at every step there is a nearer minister.

text: The Seven Master Spirits do not directly invade the material minds of the individual creatures on the evolutionary worlds of space. … If this Master Spirit does attain any sort of contact with the individual mortal mind during the earlier evolutionary ages of an inhabited world, it must occur through the ministry of the local universe Creative Spirit, the consort and associate of the Creator Son of God who presides over the destinies of each local creation.

ch11.s3.u2.k: An ascending mortal forever bears the stamp of the Master Spirit of his native superuniverse.
ch11.s3.u2.p: The physical stamp of a Master Spirit is part of man's origin, and the entire morontia career is lived under that Spirit's influence. Even after the intense culture of Paradise the mark is never erased. Origin is not a stain to be removed but a uniqueness kept forever; even in the Corps of the Finality a complete representation requires finaliters from all seven superuniverses.

text: The physical stamp of a Master Spirit is a part of man's material origin. The entire morontia career is lived under the continuing influence of this same Master Spirit. It is hardly strange that the subsequent spirit career of such an ascending mortal never fully eradicates the characteristic stamp of this same supervising Spirit.

Even the subsequent intense Paradise culture does not suffice to eradicate the earmarks of superuniverse origin. Throughout all eternity an ascendant mortal will exhibit traits indicative of the presiding Spirit of his superuniverse of nativity. Even in the Corps of the Finality, when it is desired to arrive at or to portray a complete Trinity relationship to the evolutionary creation, always a group of seven finaliters is assembled, one from each superuniverse.

ch11.s3.u3.k: In this age Master Spirit Number Seven functions for ascenders in the place of God in personal relationships.
ch11.s3.u3.p: The Supreme Being is God not yet contactable as a person. That gap is filled by Master Spirit Number Seven. He functions in the place of the God of ascendant creatures in matters of personal relationship, and he is the one high spirit whom every ascender will surely recognize on reaching the centers of glory. Even the road toward a God still emerging has its companion.

text: During the present universe age of the noncontactability of the person of the Supreme, Master Spirit Number Seven functions in the place of the God of ascendant creatures in the matter of personal relationships. He is the one high spirit being that all ascenders are certain to recognize and somewhat comprehend when they reach the centers of glory.

ch11.s4: The Unified Ministry of the Supreme Spirit Family
ch11.s4.u1.k: The seven Supreme Spirit groups are the universal co-ordinating directors of the seven-segmented administration of the grand universe.
ch11.s4.u1.p: The Supreme Spirits are not the Master Spirits alone. The Master Spirits, the Supreme Executives, and the Reflective Spirits, classed as children of the Trinity, together with the Reflective Image Aids, the Circuit Spirits, the local universe Creative Spirits, and the adjutant mind-spirits, created by the Infinite Spirit and his associates, form one family. These seven groups reach in tiers from Paradise to the primitive minds of evolutionary worlds.

text: THE seven Supreme Spirit groups are the universal co-ordinating directors of the seven-segmented administration of the grand universe. Although all are classed among the functional family of the Infinite Spirit, the following three groups are usually classified as children of the Paradise Trinity:
1. The Seven Master Spirits.
2. The Seven Supreme Executives.
3. The Reflective Spirits.
The remaining four groups are brought into being by the creative acts of the Infinite Spirit or by his associates of creative status:
4. The Reflective Image Aids.
5. The Seven Spirits of the Circuits.
6. The Local Universe Creative Spirits.
7. The Adjutant Mind-Spirits.

ch11.s4.u2.k: The creation of Majeston was the first supreme creative act of the Supreme Being.
ch11.s4.u2.p: Majeston is the personal center that co-ordinates all reflectivity phenomena in the seven superuniverses. His creation marked the first exercise of creative will by the evolving Supreme Being, and the response of the Deity Absolute went far beyond intent and forecast. That existential Deity answers so abundantly to what experiential Deity begins hints that all growth in the universe may bear fruit beyond expectation.

text: Majeston is a true person, the personal and infallible center of reflectivity phenomena in all seven superuniverses of time and space. … He is concerned solely with the co-ordination and maintenance of the reflectivity service in the far-flung creation; he is not otherwise involved in the administration of universe affairs.

The creation of Majeston signalized the first supreme creative act of the Supreme Being. This will to action was volitional in the Supreme Being, but the stupendous reaction of the Deity Absolute was not foreknown. … The Deity response to the creative wills of the Supreme Being and his associates was vastly beyond their purposeful intent and greatly in excess of their conceptual forecasts.

ch11.s4.u3.k: The Reflective Spirits preserve everything of true spiritual value in living minds.
ch11.s4.u3.p: The universe keeps both formal records and living records. The Reflective Spirits and their offspring are not mere transmitters but retentive personalities, and everything of spiritual value is registered in duplicate in their living minds. Nothing of true spiritual worth that a person achieves is forgotten; it is kept not in documents but in persons.

text: The Reflective Spirits are not merely transmitting agents; they are retentive personalities as well. Their offspring, the seconaphim, are also retentive or record personalities. Everything of true spiritual value is registered in duplicate, and one impression is preserved in the personal equipment of some member of one of the numerous orders of secoraphic personalities belonging to the vast staff of the Reflective Spirits.

The formal records of the universes are passed up by and through the angelic recorders, but the true spiritual records are assembled by reflectivity and are preserved in the minds of suitable and appropriate personalities belonging to the family of the Infinite Spirit. These are the live records in contrast with the formal and dead records of the universe, and they are perfectly preserved in the living minds of the recording personalities of the Infinite Spirit.

ch11.s4.u4.k: The Supreme Spirits unify the descending administrative levels from Paradise to the mind of mortal man.
ch11.s4.u4.p: Seen as a whole, the family of Supreme Spirits forms a single continuous chain, beginning at the presence of the Trinity and reaching to the mind of evolving mortals on the planets. They work alike with the personalities of the order of Days and with the Paradise Sons. Because the ministry of the Infinite Spirit runs unbroken in this way, even the lowliest mind is not cut off from the spiritual order of the universe.

text: The domain of the Supreme Spirits extends from the presence of the Trinity on Paradise to the functioning of mind of the evolutionary-mortal order on the planets of space. Thus do they unify the descending administrative levels and co-ordinate the manifold functions of the personnel thereof. … They function alike with the Trinity personalities of the order of "Days" and with the Paradise personalities of the order of "Sons."

ch11.qs1: Does the thought that God's spirit reaches me through several levels of spirits make God feel farther away or nearer?
ch11.qs2: If science, morality, and worship are three levels of one mind, which level is least developed in my own life?
ch11.qs3: If my origin and temperament are a uniqueness to be kept forever, how should I accept and cultivate them?
ch12.sub: Creator, Magisterial, and Trinity Teacher Sons
ch12.sum: God does not rule the universe only from afar; through the Paradise Sons he comes down into the worlds of time and space. The Creator Sons originate in the Father and the Eternal Son, the Magisterial Sons in the Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit, and the Trinity Teacher Sons in all three Deities. Their origins are three, but their spirit is one, and they serve creatures as creators, servers, bestowers, judges, and teachers. This chapter considers the unity of the three orders of Sons, the Avonals as planetary judges and servants, the true meaning of bestowal, and the Teacher Sons who open spiritual ages, together with the revelation of Deity which the three orders achieve in concert. It stresses in particular that bestowal is not a sacrifice to change the Father's mind but the way a Son lives the creature's life, reveals the Father, and becomes a sympathetic ruler.
ch12.s1: Three Orders of Sons, One Spirit
ch12.s1.u1.k: The Paradise Sons are of threefold origin, yet one in spirit and in work.
ch12.s1.u1.p: The three orders of Paradise Sons come from different associations of Deity, yet in service, worship, and supplication they are one. More remarkable still, when a Son works for a world he works as if he were the first and only Son of God. Though there are many Sons, the love each world receives is not divided.

text: The Paradise Sons of God are of threefold origin: The primary or Creator Sons are brought into being by the Universal Father and the Eternal Son; the secondary or Magisterial Sons are children of the Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit; the Trinity Teacher Sons are the offspring of the Father, Son, and Spirit. From the standpoint of service, worship, and supplication the Paradise Sons are as one; their spirit is one, and their work is identical in quality and completeness.
All the Paradise Sons of God are divine in origin and in nature. The work of each Paradise Son in behalf of each world is just as if the Son of service were the first and only Son of God.

ch12.s1.u2.k: The Father comes down to us as a person through the divine Sons, and by the same way we ascend to him.
ch12.s1.u2.p: The Father comes to us as a person through the Sons, and the way we ascend to him is the avenue the same Sons reveal. Whether in the central universe or on an inhabited planet, it is a Paradise Son who reveals the Father to men and angels. The Paradise Sons are the acting natures of Deity presented to time and space, the gift of the eternal Deities to every creature capable of ascension.

text: In the central universe, the superuniverses, the local universes, or on the inhabited planets, it is a Paradise Son who reveals the Universal Father to men and angels. The Eternal Son and his Sons reveal the avenue of creature approach to the Universal Father.

The Paradise Sons are the divine presentation of the acting natures of the three persons of Deity to the domains of time and space. The Creator, Magisterial, and Teacher Sons are the gifts of the eternal Deities to the children of men and to all other universe creatures of ascension potential.

ch12.s1.u3.k: The Paradise Sons have revealed themselves as creators, servers, bestowers, judges, teachers, and truth revealers.
ch12.s1.u3.p: If the orders of Days are divine administrators, the Sons are divine ministers. Their work runs from creation to service and bestowal, from judgment to teaching and the revelation of truth. In a local universe both Magisterial and Teacher Sons serve under the direction of the Creator Son. God's rule reaches creatures more in the form of service than of command.

text: As the Paradise orders of Days proved to be divine administrators, so have the orders of Paradise Sons revealed themselves as divine ministers—creators, servers, bestowers, judges, teachers, and truth revealers. … They are variously organized, dependent on the nature and whereabouts of their service, but in a local universe both Magisterial and Teacher Sons serve under the direction of the Creator Son who presides over that domain.

ch12.s2.u1.k: The Avonals are Sons of planetary service and bestowal and the adjudicators of the dispensations.
ch12.s2.u1.p: Each Avonal has a unique personality and serves the planets, sometimes even being born of an earthly mother. They are called Magisterial Sons because they are the high magistrates of the realms, the adjudicators of the successive dispensations of time. Their judgment is closer to setting things in order and renewing them than to punishment; closing an age is also opening the next.

text: Avonals are the Paradise Sons of service and bestowal to the individual planets of the local universes. And since each Avonal Son has an exclusive personality, since no two are alike, their work is individually unique in the realms of their sojourn, where they are often incarnated in the likeness of mortal flesh and sometimes are born of earthly mothers on the evolutionary worlds.
The Avonals are known as Magisterial Sons because they are the high magistrates of the realms, the adjudicators of the successive dispensations of the worlds of time.

ch12.s2.u2.k: The planetary work of the Avonals is backed by the full power and authority of the Creator Son.
ch12.s2.u2.p: Avonals do not work alone. Behind these secondary Paradise Sons stands the full power and authority of a primary Paradise Son, the Creator Son of their local universe, so that their work on a world is just as effective as if the Creator Son himself had served there. God's work is accomplished within a web of co-operation.

text: In every planetary effort the secondary Paradise Sons, the Avonals, are supported by the full power and authority of a primary Paradise Son, the Creator Son of their local universe of service. To all intents and purposes their work on the inhabited spheres is just as effective and acceptable as would have been the service of a Creator Son upon such worlds of mortal habitation.

ch12.s3.u1.k: The bestowal plan personalizes and makes real to creatures the love of the Father and the mercy of the Son.
ch12.s3.u1.p: Bestowal is a plan that began as the proposal of the Eternal Son. Its purpose is not merely to proclaim the love of the Father and the mercy of the Son but to live them out in the flesh. Within this plan the confession that the eternal Word was made flesh becomes literally true. Where misguided will has placed creatures in spiritual jeopardy, the Sons enter as rehabilitators.

text: The Bestowal Plan. … This is the proposal of the Eternal Son and consists of his bestowal of the Sons of God upon the evolutionary creations, there to personalize and factualize, to incarnate and make real, the love of the Father and the mercy of the Son to the creatures of all universes. Inherent in the bestowal plan, and as a provisional feature of this ministration of love, the Paradise Sons act as rehabilitators of that which misguided creature will has placed in spiritual jeopardy.

The Eternal Son is the eternal Word of God. … When a personal duplication or divine extension of this Original Son starts on a bestowal mission of mortal incarnation, it becomes literally true that the divine "Word is made flesh," and that the Word thus dwells among the lowly beings of animal origin.

ch12.s3.u2.k: Bestowal does not aim to change the Father's attitude but prepares the Son to be a sympathetic ruler.
ch12.s3.u2.p: The idea that a Son comes in order to appease an angry Father is widespread. The text plainly denies it. Bestowal is the process by which a Son, through personal experience of the creature's life, becomes a safe and sympathetic ruler. And upon the bestowal Son's return the Spirit of Truth is poured out, after which Thought Adjusters come to all normal human beings.

text: On Urantia there is a widespread belief that the purpose of a Son's bestowal is, in some manner, to influence the attitude of the Universal Father. But your enlightenment should indicate that this is not true. The bestowals of the Avonal and the Michael Sons are a necessary part of the experiential process designed to make these Sons safe and sympathetic magistrates and rulers of the peoples and planets of time and space.

Some order of Paradise Son must be bestowed upon each mortal-inhabited world in order to make it possible for Thought Adjusters to indwell the minds of all normal human beings on that sphere, for the Adjusters do not come to all bona fide human beings until the Spirit of Truth has been poured out upon all flesh; and the sending of the Spirit of Truth is dependent upon the return to universe headquarters of a Paradise Son who has successfully executed a mission of mortal bestowal upon an evolving world.

ch12.s3.u3.k: A bestowal Son is born of woman, grows up as a human being, and prays to the Father.
ch12.s3.u3.p: The heart of bestowal lies not in appearing human but in actually living a human life. A bestowal Son is born as an infant, passes through youth to manhood, and petitions the Father as do the children of that world. That a Son of God became a man who prays shows that our prayers are not a foreign tongue to God.

text: On a mortal-bestowal mission a Paradise Son is always born of woman and grows up as a male child of the realm, as Jesus did on Urantia. These Sons of supreme service all pass from infancy through youth to manhood just as does a human being. … They make petitions to the Father as do the children of the realms in which they serve.

ch12.s3.u4.k: The death of a bestowal Son is not to appease divine wrath but to complete the bestowal.
